captions.text: I think a lot of people relate to Veganism being an ultra-processed food
because of the fake meats and fake cheeses, right?
But in our restaurant, for example, we try to stick to whole foods.
We make our own cheese. Our cheese is made from cashew and water.
Even our picadillo: we literally buy a bag of pea protein,
and we make the picadillo with pea protein.

end_cta: More places like Love Life Cafe
